description.value: Home2 Suites by Hilton is a four-storey extended-stay hotel located in Fort St. John, a major service hub in northeastern BC on the Alaska Highway corridor. As an extended-stay property it typically offers suite-style rooms with kitchenettes, making it a practical base for cyclists doing multi-day trips through the Peace region. Fort St. John is a significant resupply point for anyone cycling the Alaska Highway.
